text.en: 1. This Order is the Housing and Development (Precincts for Upgrading Works) (Home Improvement Programme) Order 2020 and comes into operation on 31 January 2020.

heading.en: Declaration of precinct for Home Improvement Programme

text.en: 2. The parts of the housing estate of the Board described in the Schedule are declared to be a precinct for the purpose of carrying out upgrading works in connection with the Home Improvement Programme.

THE SCHEDULE
All that part of the housing estate of the Board bounded by Clementi Avenue 3 and Commonwealth Avenue West, comprised in Lot numbers 08232A, 03513T, 06170A, 06482A, 03515K and 06169N in Mukim 05 and on which Apartment Blocks 442, 443, 446, 447, 449 and 450 are erected, and which is more particularly shaded in the Plan.
THE PLAN
CLEMENTI AVENUE 3
